title: Trapping rain water
prompt: Given non-negative bar heights of width 1, return how many units of rain water can be trapped between the bars.

title: Edit distance
prompt: Return the minimum number of insertions, deletions, and replacements needed to turn word a into word b.

title: Longest valid parentheses
prompt: Given a string containing only '(' and ')', return the length of its longest contiguous valid parentheses substring.

title: Median of two sorted arrays
prompt: Given two sorted numeric arrays, return the median of their combined values. At least one array is non-empty. Aim for logarithmic time.

title: Minimum window substring
prompt: Return the shortest substring of s that contains every character of t with the required frequency. Return an empty string if no such substring exists.

title: Merge K sorted arrays
prompt: Merge an array of individually sorted numeric arrays into one sorted array. Handle empty inner arrays and duplicate values.

title: Word ladder
prompt: Return the number of words in the shortest transformation sequence from begin to end. Change one letter at a time; every new word must be in the word list. Return 0 if impossible.

title: Maximal rectangle
prompt: Given a grid of '0' and '1' strings, return the area of the largest rectangle containing only '1' cells.
